subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Direction and place: next to, behind, in front of, on top of (Mathematics vocabulary)

show.line: The cat is on top of the box. The dog is next to the box!

rounds.prompt: Tap the ball on top of the table.
Tap the ball behind the chair.
Tap the child in front of the bus.
Where is the bag? It is next to the...?
Which bird is under the tree?
Put your hand on top of your head. Where is your hand?

hints: On top means up on it. Under means below it.
Behind is at the back. In front is at the front.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Where is the cat?
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The cat is under the box!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The cat is on top of the box.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: The cat is on top. Up high!

parent_line: Can use words like on top, under, behind, in front of and next to.
